acceptance_criteria: Every Koelner Phonetik code-table row from the PhoneticGerman docblock is covered by an explicit assertion.
Deviations are either fixed with a specification citation or recorded as a deliberate, documented behaviour.
behavior_anchors: word input -> PhoneticInterface::phonetic_word -> phonetic code string
goal: Validate the shipped de/en/fr phonetic implementations against their published specifications with spec-anchored tests, and fix only deviations proven against the specification.
non_goals: Changing the public API of Phonetic or PhoneticInterface.
